capabilities: Install plugins from self-hosted release URLs or plugin directories
Check sources on startup and optionally install newer versions automatically
Fall back through multiple source URLs until one works
Authenticate to private Gitea repositories with an access token
Read the plugin ID automatically from manifest.json
disambiguation: Not a plugin marketplace or general plugin manager; it only installs plugins from user-defined HTTP(S) endpoints.
extras: README is flagged as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Notes that a restart of Obsidian is needed after updating an enabled plugin, and that release assets must include a freshly built main.js and manifest.json.
problem: Distributing private plugins to vaults, especially mobile vaults, normally requires manually copying plugin files to each device.
summary: Developer tool that installs and updates Obsidian plugins from self-hosted release URLs, with token-authenticated Gitea support and multi-URL fallback.
